```artifact
Feature: Patient Management and Medicine Delivery

  Scenario: Medicines are delivered as prescribed by the doctor (offline)
    Given the doctor has prescribed medicines for a patient
    When the system processes the prescription offline
    Then the medicines should be delivered as per the doctor's prescription

  Scenario: Register a new Patient
    Given the system is ready to accept new patient registrations
    When a new patient details are provided
    Then the patient should be successfully registered in the system

  Scenario Outline: View and Update the details of an existing Patient
    Given the patient with ID <patient_id> exists in the system
    When the patient details are updated with <new_details>
    Then the patient details should be updated to <new_details>
    Examples:
      | patient_id | new_details             |
      | 123        | {"name": "John Doe"}    |
      | 456        | {"age": 30}             |
      | 789        | {"name": "Jane Smith", "age": 25} |

  Scenario: Delete the Patient Details - No Consultation Requests in last 3 years
    Given the patient with ID <patient_id> has no consultation requests in the last 3 years
    When the system attempts to delete the patient details
    Then the patient details should be successfully deleted
    Examples:
      | patient_id |
      | 123        |
      | 456        |

  Scenario: Delete the Patient Details - Consultation Requests in last 3 years
    Given the patient with ID <patient_id> has consultation requests in the last 3 years
    When the system attempts to delete the patient details
    Then the system should not delete the patient details and should return an error message "Cannot delete patient with recent consultation requests"
    Examples:
      | patient_id |
      | 789        |

  Scenario: Rollback by a month
    Given the system has data for the current month
    When the system performs a rollback by a month
    Then the system should revert to the state of the previous month

  Scenario: Restore backup on dummy production system
    Given a backup of the system data exists
    When the backup is restored on the dummy production system
    Then the dummy production system should have the same data as the backup

  Scenario: Purge dummy production database
    Given the dummy production database contains data
    When the system purges the dummy production database
    Then the dummy production database should be empty
```
